Establish project execution plans, organization structures, responsibilities, project schedules, manpower requirements and resource plans in coordination with the project team. Lead and manage the project team, including Project Engineers, Site Engineers, QA/QC, HSE, Procurement, Planning, Quantity Surveying/Commercial and other project personnel. Coordinate and manage project activities from engineering and procurement through fabrication, construction, testing, commissioning and final handover. Manage day-to-day project operations and coordinate closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers and internal departments to ensure smooth project execution. Establish and maintain effective communication with clients and stakeholders, conduct regular project progress meetings and provide timely updates on project status, risks, issues and required actions. Review and manage project schedules, milestones, manpower deployment, productivity and progress, and implement recovery measures where necessary to maintain the project schedule. Monitor and control project costs, including manpower, materials, equipment, subcontractors and other project expenses, to achieve the approved project budget and targeted profitability. Review project cash flow, progress claims, invoicing, collections and outstanding receivables in coordination with the Commercial and Finance teams. Manage the procurement and delivery of major materials, equipment and services to ensure that project requirements and construction schedules are met. Manage subcontractors and suppliers, including scope definition, performance monitoring, progress evaluation and resolution of commercial and technical issues. Review and manage contractual requirements, including variations, change orders, claims, extensions of time, back-charges, liquidated damages, warranties and final accounts. Identify potential variations and commercial opportunities during project execution and ensure that appropriate documentation and contractual notifications are submitted in a timely manner. Review project risks and establish appropriate mitigation measures for technical, commercial, schedule, procurement, construction and HSE risks. Ensure that all project activities comply with applicable statutory requirements, client requirements, approved procedures, specifications, drawings, method statements and HSE requirements. Ensure implementation of project quality requirements and review QA/QC documentation, inspection and testing requirements, NCRs and corrective actions. Monitor construction progress and resolve technical, construction and interface issues in coordination with the engineering and site teams. Ensure proper project documentation, including progress reports, inspection records, testing and commissioning records, as-built drawings, operation and maintenance documentation and final handover dossiers. Lead project completion, testing, commissioning, punch-list close-out, handover and final account activities. Conduct regular internal and client project reviews and report key project performance, risks, financial status and corrective actions to senior management. Maintain and strengthen long-term relationships with clients and identify potential follow-on projects, variation opportunities and new business opportunities arising from ongoing projects. Experience in EPC, plant construction, plant modification, fabrication, maintenance or brownfield projects is highly preferred. Candidates with experience managing projects involving API 650 tanks, piping, mechanical equipment, structural works and associated civil/E&I works will have an advantage. Proven track record of managing projects from engineering and procurement through construction, testing, commissioning and handover. Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling, cost control, resource planning and project execution. Strong understanding of contract administration, variation orders, claims, extension of time (EOT), liquidated damages, back-charges and final accounts. Experience managing subcontractors, suppliers and project manpower. Strong commercial awareness with the ability to monitor project profitability, cash flow, progress claims and cost performance. Able to work independently and make timely decisions under demanding project conditions. Willing to work 5.5 days per week and be based at project sites as required. Candidate should ideally be Singapore citizens.

review_candidates.title: Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: Wie ontwerpt het fundament waarop soevereine cloudplatformen kunnen bouwen? Iedere organisatie die naar schaalbare, soevereine Cloudinfrastructuur beweegt, botst vroeg of laat op dezelfde vraag: wie zorgt dat die infrastructuur betrouwbaar, reproduceerbaar en toekomstbestendig is, zonder in te leveren op controle en portabiliteit? Als Platform Engineer is dat jouw vraagstuk. De uitdaging Als Platform Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers zoals Defensie, KLM en ASML, aan complexe infrastructuurvraagstukken op seniorniveau. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert Cloudinfrastructuur en CI/CD-pipelines, geeft vorm aan platformarchitecturen, zoals het deployen van Mendix op Kubernetes-clusters binnen Europese cloudomgevingen, en zet Kubernetes-clusters op binnen Europese Cloudproviders als STACKIT, OVH en Scaleway of binnen private Cloudomgevingen. Met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Terraform, maak je infrastructuren reproduceerbaar en schaalbaar. Je werkt nauw samen met software-, data- en AI-engineers, en met klanten om infrastructuurbehoeften te vertalen naar betrouwbare oplossingen, met oog voor soevereiniteit, autonomie en portabiliteit. Je plek: de Platform Engineering squad Je landt in de Platform Engineering squad, waar collega's elkaar scherp houden op technische keuzes en architectuur. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarop we tijd vrijmaken voor kennisdeling, leren en verbinden met de rest van LINKIT. Lees hier meer over de Platform Engineering squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in een DevOps-, Platform Engineering- of infrastructuurrol, bij voorkeur binnen de Nederlandse overheid. Aantoonbare ervaring met containers en orchestratieplatformen zoals Kubernetes en Docker, gecombineerd met CI/CD-tooling zoals GitHub Actions, GitLab CI of Jenkins, en Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Terraform. Ervaring met cloud-agnostisch werken binnen publieke en private cloudomgevingen, waaronder Europese providers als STACKIT, OVH en Scaleway en platformen zoals OpenStack. Ervaring met automatisering en scripting, met tools en talen zoals Python, Go, Ansible en/of Chef. Kennis van netwerken, beveiliging en observability binnen cloud-native en on-premise omgevingen. Affiniteit met open-source tooling en moderne data-infrastructuren, zoals datapipelines, datawarehouses, lakehouses en MLOps. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €4.300-€6.700 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling (50% premie door ons betaald of extra salaris). Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop + telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de 'clubdag'). Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten,, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Sollicitatieprocedure We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet. Kennismaking: een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is. Verdiepende gesprekken: twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Wil je alvast meer weten? Neem gerust contact op met Tabea via tabea.hensel@linkit.nl of via 06-47001022. Over LINKIT LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als Platform Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past. Rethink it with LINKIT.

Our network of battery-swapping stations lets a rider trade a depleted battery for a charged one in seconds, with no downtime — and it is live across Dubai today, in partnership with market leaders. As the rollout expands, we need people to run it. THE ROLE The BSS Network Operations & Maintenance manages the day-to-day operations of battery swap stations, ensuring smooth service delivery and operational reliability. This role involves overseeing battery supply, monitoring station performance, troubleshooting issues, supporting drivers, coordinating with technical teams, and optimizing station processes through operational data and reporting. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Run site surveys and technical assessments: available and connected load, cable sizing, breaker ratings, protection and overall power requirements Read and work from load schedules, single line diagrams and DB and panel layouts Coordinate installation, testing, commissioning, energisation, inspection and handover Supervise electrical technicians and contractor teams on live sites Plan and run preventive and corrective maintenance across chargers, panels, breakers, cabling and communication systems Monitor uptime, charger and slot status, connectivity, alarms and station performance, and troubleshoot electrical, hardware and communication faults Keep maintenance schedules, fault records, service history and spare-parts inventory in order Manage battery supply and availability so service is not interrupted, and support drivers on site when needed Ensure compliance with DEWA requirements, UAE electrical regulations, RTA approvals, HSE procedures and work permits Report weekly and monthly on installation progress, uptime, utilisation, downtime, faults and pending actions REQUIREMENTS Degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent practical qualification 2+ years in electrical installation, EV charging infrastructure or comparable field operations, UAE experience preferred Confident reading single line diagrams and load schedules, and sizing cables and breakers Experience supervising technicians or contractors on live electrical sites Working knowledge of DEWA and RTA approval processes willingness to travel across the Emirates English for reporting and client communication; an additional language spoken by site crews is an advantage Valid UAE driving licence preferred Hands-on experience with EV chargers, battery swap stations or battery management systems preferred TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES Operations & Monitoring: Swap station monitoring systems, internal reporting and optimization software Mapping & Planning: Maps for upcoming station locations Project Management & Collaboration: Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Microsoft Project, ERP (Asana), Jira Reporting & Analytics: Excel, Power BI, Tableau Communication: Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Zoom OEM Coordination: OEM portals for BSS updates, firmware, and battery management

New York University Abu Dhabi is seeking an accomplished commercial leader to drive the next phase of executive education growth for the Stern School of Business at NYU Abu Dhabi. NYU is a leading global research university, with degree-granting campuses in New York, Abu Dhabi and Shanghai. Stern at NYUAD brings the academic strength and global reach of NYU Stern to organisations and senior leaders across the UAE and wider region. Based within NYU Abu Dhabi's Office of Executive and Professional Education (OEPE) , the Assistant Director will be dedicated to Stern at NYUAD Executive Education, working closely with the Stern at NYUAD team through a dotted-line relationship. The role combines the institutional platform and resources of NYUAD with a clear commercial mandate: to build Stern's regional client base, develop strategic relationships and convert opportunities into sustainable partnerships. The successful candidate will operate across Stern, NYUAD and NYU's global network, identifying where Stern's academic and research expertise can create distinctive value for regional organisations and leading opportunities from initial engagement through solution design, proposal, negotiation and partnership. Key Responsibilities Develop the market, identifying and converting strategic opportunities across government, corporate and institutional sectors Build senior relationships and secure high-value and multi-year partnerships Lead complex bids and proposals, including potentially multi-million-dollar opportunities Shape and author propositions, translating faculty expertise and research into differentiated commercial solutions Structure partnerships, including MSAs, MOUs, pricing and commercial terms, in partnership with Finance and Legal Mobilise the NYU network, drawing on expertise and programmes across New York, Abu Dhabi and Shanghai to strengthen the regional proposition Qualifications Required Experience: The successful candidate will be a commercially credible business development leader with: 7+ years' experience in business development, strategic partnerships, corporate relations or a comparable commercial environment A demonstrable record of originating and securing high-value B2B business, ideally with government entities or major corporations Experience personally architecting, writing and leading complex proposals and bids, including multi-million-dollar opportunities Strong commercial judgement across pricing, negotiation, contracting and partnership development The ability to translate complex academic, research or technical expertise into clear, differentiated client propositions Established credibility with senior government and corporate stakeholders, particularly UAE/GCC market experience Experience in executive education, higher education, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment would be advantageous Arabic is highly desirable Additional Information Based in Abu Dhabi, the role sits at the intersection of NYUAD's institutional platform, Stern's global academic proposition and the UAE's growing demand for leadership and organisational capability development. The appointment will play an important role in determining how Stern Executive Education builds its regional market, develops strategic partnerships and translates its global academic proposition into commercial impact. NYU Abu Dhabi is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community and welcomes applications from candidates from all backgrounds.

review_candidates.description: Call Us 9122957592 English हिन्दी Home Service About Us Knowledge Base Courses Notice More Gallery Careers Tenders Student Login Employee Login Become Member Team Members Employee Login into your employee account Member Login into your member account Student Login into your student account Employee Become an employee at Manmukh Member Become a member at Manmukh Student Become a student at Manmukh Title: Tendering cum Proposal Expert Posted by Manmukh 12 May 2026 Document: View Description Tendering Management Specialist Organisation : Manmukh Education Consultancy Job Location : Ranchi / On Site / Field Coordination as Required Employment Type Full-Time | Contractual About The Organization Manmukh Education Consultancy is engaged in Skill Development, CSR Projects, Training Programs, Education Consultancy, Healthcare Initiatives, and Government-funded projects across multiple sectors. The organization works closely with Government Departments, PSUs, Corporate CSR divisions, and Sector Skill Councils to implement impactful development programs. Job Summary The Tendering Expert will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, preparing, and submitting tenders, RFPs, EOIs, DPRs, and project proposals related to Skill Development, CSR, Healthcare, Education, Livelihood, Infrastructure, and Government schemes. The candidate should possess strong knowledge of government procurement procedures, bid documentation, compliance requirements, costing, and online tender portals. The role requires excellent drafting skills, coordination abilities, analytical thinking, and experience in handling complete tender lifecycle management from tender identification to final submission and post-award documentation. Key Roles & Responsibilities Tender Identification & Analysis Monitor various Government and PSU tender portals regularly. Identify relevant tenders, EOIs, RFPs, RFQs, and CSR opportunities. Analyze tender eligibility criteria, technical specifications, and financial requirements. Evaluate feasibility and suitability of tender participation. Tender Documentation Prepare complete tender documents as per bid requirements. Draft technical proposals, financial proposals, compliance sheets, and supporting documents. Prepare detailed DPRs (Detailed Project Reports), project proposals, presentations, and concept notes. Ensure all required annexures, declarations, affidavits, and certifications are properly attached. Portal Management Handle Online Bid Submissions Through Portals Such As GEM Portal CPP Portal State e-Tender Portals PSU Procurement Portals Upload documents and ensure error-free online submission before deadlines. Manage DSC (Digital Signature Certificate) usage and portal registrations. Coordination & Communication Coordinate with management, finance teams, training departments, and external partners for required documents. Communicate with government departments and tender authorities regarding clarifications and corrigendum's. Maintain strong vendor and institutional relationships. Financial & Compliance Management Prepare costing and budgeting for project proposals. Ensure compliance with procurement guidelines and tender conditions. Track EMDs, tender fees, performance guarantees, and contract obligations. Maintain records of submitted and awarded tenders. Post-Award Responsibilities Assist in agreement execution and documentation after award. Coordinate for project implementation readiness. Maintain project files and reporting systems. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Management, Commerce, Engineering, Finance, Law, or related field. Additional certification in Procurement, Tendering, or Project Management will be preferred. Required Experience Minimum 2–5 years of experience in Tendering, Procurement, Bid Management, or Proposal Writing. Experience in Government, PSU, CSR, NSDC, Skill Development, Healthcare, or Education sector preferred. Prior experience in handling GEM and e-tender portals is highly desirable. Required Skills/Technical Skills Tender drafting and bid preparation DPR and proposal writing Budgeting and costing Knowledge of procurement procedures MS Office proficiency (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) Portal handling and online submission Soft Skills Excellent written and verbal English communication Strong analytical and documentation skills Time management and deadline handling Attention to detail Team coordination abilities Preferred Knowledge Areas CSR Project Management Skill Development Schemes Government Procurement Policies NSDC & Sector Skill Council Frameworks Labour Law Compliance Vendor Management Contract Documentation All Sectors Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Number of tenders submitted successfully Tender success/winning ratio Accuracy and compliance in documentation Timely submission of bids Quality of technical and financial proposals Salary How To Apply Salary will be based on experience, qualifications, and expertise.
